lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Mg12H2 (YMg6H) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: H centers have 12 geometric neighbors (2 Mg, 10 Y), while Mg and Y centers each show 12 neighbors with varying Mg, H, and Y compositions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between H- and Mg-centered polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 16 sites.
